story.iWant: I want to create and manage "classes" to organize my study materials,
story.soThat: So that I can easily group related content.

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: **Given** I am logged in and on my content management page **When** I create a new class **Then** the class is added to my list of classes. **And** I can rename and delete existing classes. **And** when I delete a class, I receive a confirmation dialog stating that all associated content will also be deleted. **And** class names shall be limited to 25 alphanumeric characters. **And** if a user attempts to create a class with a name that already exists, the system shall display an error message: 'A class with this name already exists. Please choose a different name.'

artifact.title: Product Requirements Document
artifact.snippet: Empower users to easily upload, organize, and manage their study materials, creating a structured and clutter-free learning environment.

artifact.title: Product Requirements Document
artifact.snippet: The system shall allow users to organize their uploaded materials and generated content into a hierarchical structure (e.g., classes, class sections).

artifact.title: AI Study Buddy - High-Level Architecture
artifact.snippet: The database will be implemented in Supabase (PostgreSQL). The schema is designed to support a hierarchical content organization and the relationships between study materials and generated content. Contains definitions for `classes` and `class_sections` tables.

artifact.title: AI Study Buddy - High-Level Architecture
artifact.snippet: Lists API endpoints related to `classes` and `class_sections` for creation, retrieval, updating, and deletion.

artifact.title: AI Study Buddy - High-Level Architecture
artifact.snippet: Row Level Security (RLS) will be enabled on all user data tables in Supabase to ensure strict data isolation. Relevant for class management.

artifact.reason: Initializes the Supabase client, essential for interacting with the Supabase backend for class management.

constraint.description: Row Level Security (RLS) must be enabled on the `classes` table in Supabase to ensure strict data isolation, allowing users to only access their own classes.
Class names shall be limited to 25 alphanumeric characters.
When a class is deleted, all associated content (class sections, documents, generated content) must also be deleted (cascading delete).
If a user attempts to create a class with a name that already exists, the system shall display an error message: 'A class with this name already exists. Please choose a different name.'

tests.standards: The project utilizes Jest with `jest-environment-jsdom` and React Testing Library for comprehensive unit and integration testing. A strict "no-flaky-tests" policy is enforced to maintain test reliability. Critical security measures, such as Row Level Security (RLS) policies, are also verified through automated tests.

ideas.idea: Verify a new class can be successfully created and added to the user's list of classes.
Verify an existing class can be renamed.
Verify an existing class can be deleted, and a confirmation dialog is displayed.
Verify all associated content (sections, documents, generated content) is deleted when a class is deleted (cascading delete).
Verify class names are limited to 25 alphanumeric characters.
Verify an error message is displayed if a user attempts to create a class with a name that already exists.
Verify only the authenticated user can create/manage their own classes (RLS enforcement).
